name: iShares Bitcoin Trust
idea: Bitcoin held by a custodian, bought and sold like a share.
strategy: Holds bitcoin directly with an institutional custodian, so the share price tracks the bitcoin price less the fee. It removes the need to manage private keys or use a crypto exchange, which is the entire reason it gathered assets faster than any ETF launch in history. The underlying asset produces no cash flow, so there is nothing to value it against.

ucits.name: European investors use exchange-traded products rather than UCITS funds
ucits.note: UCITS rules do not permit a single-asset crypto fund.
